first:
Data cleaning is surprisingly draining, especially when you're staring at hundreds of rows of messy text. You've got the hardest part—the structure and logic—all set up now. 

The actual manual review will be much easier with fresh eyes anyway. Go take a well-deserved break and step away from the spreadsheet! Whenever you come back to it and if you need anything else, I'll be here. Have a good rest!

turns.user: I'm good, let's keep going. Okay — can you give me that Apps Script that (a) works from a Raw sheet, (b) creates a Clean sheet (without overwriting Raw), (c) normalizes Y/N, phones, timestamps, maps PreferredPark using a ParkMap sheet, (d) flags duplicates (same email OR same name within 10 minutes), and (e) keeps the most recent submission per email while marking others as SUPERSEDED and marking rows needing manual review? Make it idempotent (safe to re-run) and keep all helper columns so I can inspect them.

Nice — this is great. A couple of tweaks I need:

1) Change the SUPSERSEDED logic so it keeps the earliest submission per email (first one) instead of the most recent. If timestamps are identical, fall back to keeping the row with the smaller rawIndex (i.e., the top/earlier row).

2) Phones: instead of storing as a leading-apostrophe string, format Clean_Phone as (123) 456-7890 for 10-digit numbers. For 7-digit numbers, if there's a default area code in Settings!B1, prepend that area code and format; if Settings!B1 is empty, leave as REVIEW.

3) Add a small summary sheet named CleaningSummary (created/overwritten each run) with counts:
   - Total raw rows
   - Rows marked REVIEW
   - Rows marked SUPERSEDED
   - Unique emails (count of distinct non-empty emailKey)
   - Count per canonical park (from Clean_Park)

4) Keep everything else the same and still idempotent.  

Can you send the updated Apps Script with just those changes?

Nice — two quick tweaks before I run it:

1) If a row has no parseable timestamp, make the SUPERSEDED logic fall back to rawIndex (so earliest row per email is kept). Right now it only marks SUPERSEDED when tsMs exists.  
2) Add a Review_Reasons column listing which checks caused REVIEW (e.g., "YN, Phone, Park, DUP-email, DUP-name-time, MissingTimestamp") so I can filter easily.

Can you send the updated script with just those changes?

One more small tweak: can you update the script so CleaningSummary includes one more metric "Rows kept (final)" defined as rows where Flag_Superseded is blank AND Review_Status = "OK"? Send just the updated script with that addition.

Nice — one more tweak: can you add an "Auto_Action" column that automatically marks rows as "AUTO-KEEP" / "AUTO-DELETE" when they're exact duplicates (same email OR blank email but same name) AND all cleaned fields (Clean_YN, Clean_Phone, Clean_Park) are identical? Rules:
- For same-email groups: keep the earliest (as current logic). For any other rows in that email group that are exact duplicates of the kept row, mark AUTO-DELETE; if identical to kept row but not earliest, still AUTO-DELETE.
- For rows with blank email: within same-name groups flagged by DUP-name-time, if two rows have identical cleaned fields, mark the earlier row AUTO-KEEP and the later one AUTO-DELETE.
- Leave Auto_Action blank for anything that isn't an exact auto-resolvable duplicate.

Keep everything else the same and idempotent. Send just the updated script.

turns.text:
Awesome, glad you got it all running! You now have a repeatable, one-click pipeline whenever new survey responses come in. 

Now you really can go take that break—have a great rest of your day, and reach out anytime if you need anything else!
